title: Devs and artist who are against AI are a hypocrite
author: ETZEEA
selftext:
They all talk about their love of process of making arts or artistic value in gamedev, but its just what the industry needed, someone who has the skill to bring forth what the industry have in mind, and they pay money to get that. 

If they really like the process of making it and not because of money, why charge money?

Gamedev who doesnt use AI and passionate about their skills, process, of making their dream game, good for you, why selling it once you're done? Because money.

They shame people who use AI as a tool to bring our dream game to life, some people use it for personal, some use it for commercial, and same thing, people who use it for commercial made it so they can get money.

Whether theres the use of AI or not, all leads to money. We just want to get money.
